integrity: Explicit proof of geometric classification uses the exact Cartier matrix and irreducible quadratics, with standalone finite-field verification. Results are not independently externally validated.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the smooth cyclic-six genus-three pencil in characteristic 13. Parameter involution orbits are not a full abstract isomorphism classification; Newton polygons not determined. Possible unindexed equivalent computation is an originality risk.
title: Exact Cartier strata in the characteristic-thirteen cyclic-six genus-three pencil
